lines.beaver: 회원님, 운동 시작하고 한 달 됐네요. 어떠세요?
lines.beaver_en: It's been a month since you started. How is it?
lines.beaver_roman: hoewonnim, undong sijakago han dal dwaenneyo. eotteoseyo?
lines.en: People tell me my lower body got firmer.
I used to get out of breath, but now I'm fine.
I break into a cold sweat less when I work out.
It hurts less to hold the barbell with both hands.

lines.beaver_en: Your grip improved. And your fingers?
lines.en: I think my thumbs got stronger.
My arms and legs feel lighter, and my veins show well.

lines.beaver: 혈액순환이 좋아졌나 봐요. 땀은 많이 나요?
lines.beaver_en: Your circulation must be better. Do you sweat a lot?
lines.beaver_roman: hyeoraeksunhwani joajyeonna bwayo. ttameun mani nayo?
lines.en: My armpits sweat a lot, so I wipe them often.

lines.beaver_en: Hygiene matters too. How do you hold the equipment?
lines.en: I wear gloves instead of using bare hands.

lines.beaver_en: Good job. Do you drink enough water?
lines.learner: 네, 신장에 좋다는 소리를 듣고 많이 마셔요.
lines.en: Yes, I heard it's good for the kidneys, so I drink a lot.
lines.roman: ne, sinjange jotaneun sorireul deutgo mani masyeoyo.

lines.beaver: 얼굴도 좋아 보여요. 다음 주에 또 봬요.
lines.beaver_en: Your face looks good too. See you next week.
lines.beaver_roman: eolguldo joa boyeoyo. daeum jue tto bwaeyo.
lines.en: Thank you! See you next week.
